evaluation_clock.rule: Every weekly input must be traceable to the exact published release/vintage actually available by the Friday cutoff.

source_rules.release_rule: H.10 Monday 16:15 ET for the previous business week's daily observations.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: Use only daily observations contained in an H.10 release published by cutoff.
source_rules.historical_vintage_rule: Bind the exact Board release/version containing the selected observation; no later correction or methodology vintage may silently replace it.

source_rules.release_rule: Monthly BLS PPI scheduled release at 08:30 ET.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: Use the WPU0561 vintage published in the most recent BLS PPI release available by cutoff. Carry that released vintage across weekly Score dates only until a newer eligible BLS PPI release appears; measure staleness from release date, not reference-month date.
source_rules.historical_vintage_rule: Archived BLS PPI release evidence is mandatory because PPI values can be revised for four months. Current revised history is not an allowed substitute.

source_rules.release_rule: H.8 Friday generally 16:15 ET; holiday Friday shifts to Thursday.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: Use only the seasonally adjusted bank-credit observation present in the H.8 release published by cutoff.
source_rules.historical_vintage_rule: Release-vintage snapshot is mandatory because H.8 is subject to benchmark revisions, reclassifications and corrections. Latest revised history is not an allowed substitute.

source_rules.release_rule: H.4.1 Thursday generally 16:30 ET; Wednesday level is eligible only after release.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: Use only the Primary Credit Wednesday level contained in the H.4.1 release available by cutoff.
source_rules.historical_vintage_rule: Bind exact release provenance; corrections after the historical cutoff cannot replace the originally available value without an explicit vintage record.

source_rules.release_rule: H.4.1 Thursday generally 16:30 ET; Wednesday level is eligible only after release.
source_rules.point_in_time_rule: Use only the Total Assets Wednesday level contained in the H.4.1 release available by cutoff.
source_rules.historical_vintage_rule: Bind exact release provenance; corrections after the historical cutoff cannot silently replace the originally available value.

normalization.history_scope: strictly prior complete candidate weeks only

score.weight_derivation: Equal absolute re-normalization over the five surviving factors; no v2.1E candidate Score or v2.1F real-data result was available when frozen.
score.regime_band_derivation: Carried forward before results from the v2.1E weighted-z-score scale convention because absolute weights remain normalized to 1.0; not empirically re-fit.

execution_preconditions_before_any_live_: separate explicit owner authorization limited to live vintage feasibility only
network allowlist limited to direct official Federal Reserve Board and BLS endpoints
no API key, paid account, paid source or contractual acceptance
no public artifact, research-ledger or Production mutation
additional_preconditions_before_full_can: live BLS WPU0561 historical archive/vintage feasibility passes
retained H.10, H.8 and H.4.1 archive paths are revalidated for the authorized window
all five streams have conservative point-in-time release/vintage reconstruction
a second separate explicit owner authorization permits full v2.1F candidate research
anti_tuning_rules: No transform may change after any v2.1F real-data result is viewed without a new preregistration version.
No hard acceptance threshold may be relaxed after results are viewed.
No slot may be dropped, added, proxied or reweighted to rescue a failed candidate.
No current revised BLS or H.8 history may substitute for the historical release vintage in a point-in-time study.
No H.15, FRED, ALFRED, Treasury-current-history, Wayback or other rate proxy may be introduced under this preregistration.
No current-week observation may enter its own normalization history.
No regime band may be re-fit from v2.1F candidate results under this preregistration.
No predictive investment-performance claim is authorized.
